statement: "What share of headline charity impact findings replicate when they are tested again?"
progress: "A systematic replication project covering a defined set of influential findings, publishing the rate with confidence bounds."
conditions: ["silence-about-failure", "measurement-gap"]
status: open
bounty: "Unfunded. The Question Bounties program will attach prizes once it is funded."

## Why it matters

The [Replication Program](/programs/replication-program/) describes published checks in psychology and deworming research. Charitology has not established an equivalent sector-wide rate for charity impact findings. Donors deserve to know how much to trust a headline.

## Where to start

Choose a fixed list of widely cited findings, pre-register the replication plan and publish everything, including findings that replicate. See the [Replication Program](/programs/replication-program/).
